v2.3.2 (August 29, 2026)
 • Added Pause/Resume buttons to the notification
 • Improved notification management (clearable, updated status messages)
 • Resolved UI warnings and fixed localized strings
 • Improved background service stability

 v2.3.1-fix2 (August 22, 2026)
 • Fixed connectivity issues and binding deadlocks
 • Fixed 404 error when checking for updates
 • Improved VPN service stability and responsiveness

 v2.3.1 (August 22, 2026)
 • Fixed concurrent testing bug in "Test All"
 • Added test results to all strategy pickers
 • Improved stability and site tester cleanup
 • Fixed UI infinite loading and warnings
 • Optimized configuration presets

 v2.3.0 (August 21, 2026)
 The Stability & Connectivity Update

 • Stability Fix: Resolved an issue where the VPN would disconnect after several seconds on certain strategies.
 • Centered Toggle: Redesigned the Home screen for better visual balance and accessibility.
 • Application Modes: Added "Proxy Mode" to run the bypass engine without a system-wide VPN.
 • Static Shortcuts: Long-press the app icon to instantly start or stop the service from your launcher.
 • Improved Site Tester: Added detailed TLS and HTTP verification results with robust timeout handling.
 • Refined UI: The strategy selection menu is now scrollable and supports large lists of pinned items.

v2.2.0 (July 14, 2026)
 The Connectivity & QOL Update

 • New YouTube Strategies: Added updated working strategies for YouTube in restricted regions.
 • Check for Updates: Added a modern in-app update system to keep you on the latest version.
 • Uptime Tracker: Monitor your active session time directly on the home screen.
 • Backup & Restore: Export and import your entire configuration (strategies, apps, themes) easily.
 • IPv6 Toggle: New advanced setting to enable or disable IPv6 support in the VPN tunnel.
 • Log Export: Quickly copy or share native logs for troubleshooting.
 • App Shortcut: Long-press the app icon to start/stop the bypass instantly.

v2.1.0 (July 7, 2026)
 The Strategy Control Update

 • Pinned Strategies: Pin your favorite strategies in the Testing tab for quick access.
 • Quick Switch: Change the current strategy directly from the main screen.
 • Stability fixes: General bug fixes and performance improvements.


v2.0.0 (June 23, 2026)
 The Maximum Optimization Update

 • Platform Support: Full support for Android 17 (API 37). Minimum requirement is now Android 11 (API 30).
 • Core Improvements: Fixed an issue where the "Connect" button would occasionally fail to initiate the connection.
 • Language Selection: Added a dedicated language button in Settings for quick switching (EN, RU, UK, KK).
 • Library Updates: All internal libraries and dependencies have been updated to their latest stable versions.
 • Extreme Size Reduction: APK size minimized through R8 Full Mode and ABI filtering (ARM only).
 • Resource Management: Optimized locale filtering to preserve all supported languages while stripping redundant resources.
 • Bytecode Stripping: All Log.d, Log.i, and Log.v calls are now removed at the bytecode level in release builds.
 • Metadata Purge: Removed unnecessary Kotlin metadata and ProGuard attributes.


v1.4.1 (June 14, 2026)
 The Protocol & Cleanup Update

 • HTTP Verification: Added full HTTP support to strategy verification. Now checks both TLS and plain HTTP availability.
 • Roblox Decommissioned: Completely removed the "Roblox" preset and its domain mappings because of the unblock in Russia.
 • Codebase Optimization: Purged unused helper functions and orphaned UI components to improve maintainability.


v1.4.0 (June 01, 2026)
 The Performance & Engine Update

 • TLS Strategy Testing: Added TLS handshake verification to find the most effective bypass parameters for your network.
 • Hyper-Fast Launch: Parallelized configuration loading and offloaded heavy JSON processing to background threads for instant app startup.
 • Interactive Diagnostics: New system-wide check for IPv6 leaks, battery optimizations, and TCP timestamp interference.
 • Visual Identity: Integrated simple-icons library for high-quality, brand-specific icons (YouTube, Discord, etc.).
 • Screen Persistence: Screen now stays active automatically during diagnostics and strategy testing.
 • Engine Stability: Migrated VPN lifecycle to Kotlin Coroutines and implemented socket watchdogs to prevent UI freezes.


v1.3.1 (May 29, 2026)
 Stability & Refactoring

 • Refactored UI state management for better stability and predictability
 • Optimized DPI-bypass configuration logic to prevent connection resets
 • Improved resource handling and resolved technical debt in UI layer
 • Modernized color parsing system using KTX extensions


v1.3.0 (May 29, 2026)
 Smoothness & QOL

 • Animations in navigation bar were optimized, now they are smooth and cool
 • Added IP & port strings to Current Configuration in Main Tab
 • Added notification when testing strategies
 • Fixed filling bar in strategies test (it was not filling correctly before)
 • Added Global Mode to bypass all sites at once, also added Exclude Apps from VPN setting


v1.2.1 (May 29, 2026)
 Maintenance Update

 • Added modern navigation bar to match modern style
 • Resolved Quick Settings tile issues on Android 14+ devices
 • Added smooth item animations in the Strategy Testing list
 • Hardened internal broadcast security for Android 13+ compliance
 • Optimized VPN lifecycle management and state synchronization


v1.2.0 (May 29, 2026)
 Stability & Roblox Support

 • Expanded Roblox preset with comprehensive infrastructure domains and IP ranges
 • Fixed crash when rapidly toggling VPN from Quick Settings tile
 • Enforced 0.3s debounce on Tile interactions to prevent race conditions
 • Unified Settings and Testing into a single streamlined tab
 • Optimized LogViewer with monospaced typography and batched UI updates
 • Added "History" view to the changelog dialog


v1.1.0 (May 29, 2026)
 Material Design Overhaul

 • Fully redesigned UI following Material 3 guidelines
 • Enhanced Home screen with status animations and active config overview
 • New Settings layout with logical grouping and improved readability
 • Integrated Changelog and credits viewer
 • Added Quick Settings Tile for rapid VPN control
 • Improved VPN lifecycle management and connection speed
 • Russian localization for all new interface elements


v1.0.0 (May 29, 2026)
 Initial Release

 • Core DPI bypass functionality
 • Multiple bypass strategies support
 • Basic site list management
 • Real-time connection logging
